usedFor: Brix runs digital signage on screens and HubSpot tracks the accounts behind them. A “New Screen” in Brix can open a record with “Create Deal”, useful when each screen you install is a customer rollout.

bestTemplate.name: “New Screen” in Brix, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A new screen is the clearest sign a customer is expanding, and “Create Deal” puts it on the pipeline. The restored and recalled content triggers are about content, not sales.

watchOut: “New Screen” and “New Media” are polling, so they run on a schedule. “New Restored Content” and “New Recalled Content” are pushed as they happen.
